# Pat Lib Online
> LLM-first UI pattern library with prompt-mode and code-mode retrieval contracts.

## Canonical Entry Points

- Root: `https://pat-lib-online.vercel.app/`
- LLM UI index: `https://pat-lib-online.vercel.app/llm`
- Machine index: `https://pat-lib-online.vercel.app/api/llm/index`
- Root JSON index: `https://pat-lib-online.vercel.app/llm-index.json`
- Retrieval API: `https://pat-lib-online.vercel.app/api/llm/search`
- Contracts API: `https://pat-lib-online.vercel.app/api/llm/contracts`
- Sitemap: `https://pat-lib-online.vercel.app/sitemap.xml`

## Retrieval Strategy

### Fast Route (query-driven)
1. Call `/api/llm/search?q=<task>&scope=all&mode=prompt|code`.
2. Read top `patterns`, `playbooks`, and `references` results.
3. Resolve selected entries with detail endpoints.

### Deterministic Route (full control)
1. Read `/api/llm/index` for taxonomy + endpoint map.
2. Filter `/api/llm/patterns` using `q`, `industry`, `category`, `tag`, `mode`.
3. Read `/api/llm/patterns/[id]` for:
   - `modes.prompt.pack` (context, constraints, checks, failure handling)
   - `modes.code.pack` (implementation checklist + compatibility rules)
4. Read `/api/llm/playbooks/[slug]` for integrated prompt/code plans.
5. Read `/api/llm/references/[id]` for guardrails and technical constraints.

## Stable Identifiers

- Human ID: `1.4`
- Canonical ID: `patlib.pattern.1.4`
- Canonical URL: `/library/1.4`

Both ID forms can be used with `/api/llm/patterns/[id]`.

## Query Parameters

### `/api/llm/patterns`
- `q`: free-text query
- `mode`: `prompt` or `code`
- `industry`: industry keyword
- `category`: category keyword
- `tag`: repeatable or comma-separated tag
- `limit`: max records

### `/api/llm/playbooks`
- `q`, `industry`, `mode`, `limit`

### `/api/llm/references`
- `q`, `mode`, `limit`

### `/api/llm/search`
- `q`, `scope` (`all|patterns|playbooks|references`), `mode`, `industry`, `category`, `tag`, `limit`

## Output Contracts

- `/api/llm/contracts` provides field-level contract expectations for:
  - pattern summary/detail
  - playbook detail
  - reference detail

## Human Navigation

- `/library`: full pattern catalog
- `/playbooks`: industry playbooks
- `/reference`: indexed markdown guides from `lib-files/`
